summary: A single copy of a Reaction (one source) may not be taken more than once to the same trigger (Comprehensive Rules, Abilities), enforced for once-per-turn Reactions by recording the source in the open reaction window (R-089). Identical copies still each react once (issues #898, #900); printed multi-use Reactions (Mochitoko, Rika, Governor's Estate) are outside the rule.
validation: reaction-per-trigger 1/1 with a control that fails without the record; wave-816, wave-821-cards, single-reaction-5 fixed; full check pending
remaining: None for the engine; no client check.
